tasks.title: Establish owner-only intake and exclusive agent claims
acceptance: Create and populate the project with owner-approved tasks.
Reject duplicate claims atomically and retain permanent claim receipts.
Prevent discovery from fetching issue, comment, review or project-item content.
Document portable discovery, manual triage and abandoned-worker recovery; test races and trust failures.

tasks.title: Map typed compiler and result metadata boundaries
acceptance: Inventory existing declaration, projection, collation and runtime metadata paths with source references.
Propose ordered, bounded extraction tasks and explicit deterministic/effect boundaries.
Describe acceptance tests and dependencies without changing Rust code or claiming compatibility completion.

tasks.title: Inventory TDS protocol gaps and independent verification tasks
acceptance: Compare implemented packet/token/RPC/session behavior with the local TDS skill and tests.
Distinguish tested behavior, unsupported behavior and unknown coverage with source references.
Propose bounded implementation tasks with wire fixtures and acceptance criteria; do not change code or run shared server tests.
